trust_decision.summary: MISMATCH: the advisory decision is whether a gateway secret's api_base names a public upstream, but the given fix commit adds a raw-proxy feature with no api_base check. At the pinned commit, api_base is stored unvalidated by the secret create/update handlers and the store, then dialled unchecked by _aiohttp_post and LiteLLM.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'unvalidated api_base'. An engineer would first look where auth_config api_base is copied into the provider config, or at the create-secret handler mlflow/server/handlers.py:5084.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler (new feature, not a guard)
provider base helper (loosens a User-Agent prefix match to a substring match)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: LiteLLM fallback route: api_base is not in the auth_config here; the egress target comes from LiteLLM kwargs (base_url, model_list) spread from auth_config|secret_value. A solver could argue that is a third-party client and out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Self-hosted upstreams (Ollama on localhost, Databricks host, Azure api_base, http:// dev endpoints) must keep working when opted in. Latest gates these behind MLFLOW_GATEWAY_API_BASE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS / ALLOWED_SCHEMES. A blanket private-IP block breaks them.
